default.title: Toast closeout-safe preorder posting
default.summary: ClawPilot now keeps prepaid-order accounting visible while preventing QuickBooks posting until Toast payment and fulfillment evidence is final.
features: A visible provisional Payment Exceptions journal while the payment business day is active
Separate Paid and Closed evidence in the Toast order drawer
Actionable reload states for day closeout, payment capture, Toast check closeout, and batch details
Linked payment-date capture and fulfillment-date release without duplicate sales
fixes: Payment journals cannot post before the restaurant's Toast business-day cutoff
Card payment journals remain held until Toast reports CAPTURED
Sales Receipts and release journals remain held until every active Toast check is CLOSED
Voided Toast activity no longer contributes accounting dates, totals, or closeout holds
Predeployment drafts now fail closed until regenerated through the current closeout rules
Payments without paidBusinessDate use the exact Toast cutoff or remain blocked
Missing or invalid restaurant timezones now block posting instead of falling back to UTC
Stored orders must be refreshed from Toast after closeout before a posting becomes ready
A prepared posting cannot be reused or approved after its accounting content changes
